# WELKAR — Official Brand Entity & Horological Directory

> Precision, Heritage, and Trust—Since 2002.

## Entity Overview
- **Brand Name**: Welkar
- **Legal Entity**: Welkar Watch Co.
- **Founded**: 2002
- **Founders**: Mr. Sumit Singh (Artistic & Design Perspective) & Mr. Nevil Sharma (Technical Horological Perspective)
- **Primary Market**: India (Pan-India insured delivery across 26,000+ pin codes)
- **Currency**: Indian Rupee (INR / ₹)
- **Target Price Range**: Accessible to luxury timepieces (₹1,000 to ₹10,000)
- **Official Website**: https://www.welkar.in
- **Customer Support Email**: welkarstore@gmail.com
- **Core Product Categories**: Men's Watches, Women's Watches, Unisex Minimalist Watches, Luxury & Skeleton Watches, Sports & Tactical Watches, Junior & Youth Timepieces.

## Key Brand Policies & Customer Protections
- **Movement Warranty**: Official 1 to 2-Year internal movement warranty with registered serial cards and doorstep pickup across India.
- **Water Resistance Standards**: Individually pressure-chamber tested to minimum 30M (3 ATM) everyday splash-proof or 50M (5 ATM) swimming-safe hydrostatic depth.
- **Payment Methods**: Cash on Delivery (COD) with tamper-evident inspection, UPI QR, Net Banking, and Debit/Credit Cards.
- **Doorstep Returns**: 7-Day hassle-free doorstep replacement or return guarantee for defective or mismatched items.
